##### Project general facts

SOL Bay is an opulent residential and commercial tower by SOL Properties. Rising to seventeen storeys, this latest development offers studios and one and two-bedroom apartments with direct views of the Burj Khalifa, creating an unparalleled luxury living experience. The building features high-end retail outlets and restaurants on the ground floor, offices on the podium levels, and residential apartments above, offering a seamless blend of urban living and convenience.

Residents enjoy an exceptional range of amenities designed to complement an active and sophisticated lifestyle. A fully equipped gymnasium supports daily fitness routines, while an extensive swimming pool offers respite from the heat and an opportunity to supplement workouts. The exquisitely landscaped leisure deck provides the perfect setting to enjoy the company of friends and neighbors while watching the sunset over the magical cityscape.

Every apartment at SOL Bay is thoughtfully designed to maximize space, light, and views, with every room flooded with natural daylight through full-height window walls. The interiors are executed using the best materials, featuring meticulous detailing and elegant finishes that appeal to sophisticated tastes. The contemporary splendor of the living spaces makes residents feel like they are part of Dubai's iconic landscape.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Business Bay, on the south side of Downtown Dubai, this exceptional location is a very stylish and up-to-date community at the forefront of the latest trends. The area features hotel towers, amazing restaurants, and wonderful residential properties, creating a vibrant and fast-paced lifestyle. The district hosts plenty of events, including music festivals and celebrations, keeping life lively and engaging throughout the year.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional convenience and proximity to key destinations. Famous and international schools, medical facilities, supermarkets, banks, and finance centers are just minutes away, elevating the standard of living with easy and intuitive options at every turn. The area seamlessly combines the energy of urban living with the tranquility of waterfront views.

For those seeking a residence that embodies contemporary luxury, strategic connectivity, and a prime Dubai address, Business Bay delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of stylish community, world-class amenities, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can seek refuge in a world full of pleasure, success, and fun — sophisticated, connected and effortlessly inspiring.
